conviction.explanation: Current-session English batch refresh. Analyst sentiment, scale, and technical momentum favor the bull case, while weak cash conversion and forward valuation limit conviction.

executive_summary: Amazon has $716.9B revenue, a 10.8% net margin, and a 21.9x trailing P/E, but free cash flow is only $7.7B and the 26.4x forward P/E is higher than the trailing multiple. Price is above all major moving averages with RSI at 63.9 and a positive MACD histogram, although volume is only 59% of its 20-day average.

bear_case: Low free-cash-flow conversion and a forward P/E above the trailing P/E leave the valuation exposed if earnings estimates weaken.

Sensitivity to consumer-cycle and interest-rate conditions
